english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who tends to talk a lot, without necessarily judging them negatively.

examples.english: They’re really talkative—you can chat with them all evening even when you first meet.
examples.traditional: 佢真係好多嘢講，第一次見面都可以同你傾成晚。
